answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before trading, and let verified peers vouch for it in a widening spiral of endorsements earned only through completed, checkable work. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, with small limits that rise slowly. It cannot clone a good record onto a fresh island of fake identities, because each identity needs its own stake, history, and waiting period. An attacker must therefore pay and wait for every fake, and fraud forfeits the stake, so mass fakery becomes expensive and unprofitable.
